prose: Suno has launched Speech in public beta on web and mobile. It generates spoken voices from scripts or prompts and can add AI background music in the same track. Suno calls it the first audio model that generates voice and music together.
The Verge notes AI speech is not new, with ElevenLabs and Adobe established, and suggests Suno is diversifying away from music generation, which has attracted many lawsuits.
highlights: Speech: voiceover plus background music in one track, public beta.
Available on Suno web and mobile.
The Verge links diversification to the lawsuits over its music generator.
